faq.question: How is the industry site different from the landing page?
faq.answer: The landing page is a custom design built in 14 days. The industry site is our ready-made demo tailored to your business, so it is faster and costs less.

faq.question: My industry is not on the list. What now?
faq.answer: Then the landing page or the business website is a better fit. Take the quote quiz and we will suggest the right plan from your answers.

faq.question: How many days does the industry site take?
faq.answer: 7 days, and the deadline is written into the contract.

faq.question: Can I add features later?
faq.answer: Yes, as options from the price list: online payments, reviews, messengers, a second language, CRM. Option prices are on this page.

faq.answer: One page with a custom design, a lead form, analytics and basic SEO. Everything else is an option: online booking, payments, a quiz, a calculator, a blog, CRM. Option prices are on this page.

faq.question: How many revisions are included?
faq.answer: Two rounds of revisions. Extra revisions are billed at the hourly rate from the price list.

faq.question: Will AI search find the site?
faq.answer: Every plan includes schema.org, llms.txt, FAQ markup, OG and hreflang, so the site is ready for AI search. We do not promise a place in the results.

meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: What data the MRSHKN studio website collects, why, where it goes and how to withdraw your consent.

operator.title: Who processes your data
paragraphs: The data controller is Nikolay Murashkin, a self-employed professional in Russia trading as MRSHKN studio.
For any question about your data, email hello@mrshkn.com.

data.title: What data we collect
paragraphs: From the request you send through the brief on this website:
items: your name;
how to reach you: phone, email or messenger handle;
your brief answers: what you need built, industry, style, timing, budget and comments;
campaign tags, if you came from an ad.

purposes.title: Why we process it
paragraphs: We use request data to reply to you, discuss your project and prepare a proposal.
We use analytics data to see website traffic and understand which pages and ads work.

basis.title: Legal basis
paragraphs: We process your data based on your consent. You consent to the processing of your request by ticking the box in the brief before sending it, and to analytics cookies by clicking “Accept” in the cookie banner.

transfer.title: Where your data goes
paragraphs: The name and contact details from your request, together with your brief answers, are sent to Telegram: the studio's bot posts a notification about each new request to the studio's group chat. The site's server reaches Telegram through Cloudflare, so these details pass through Cloudflare on their way to Telegram. Telegram and Cloudflare are services based outside Russia.
A copy of your request is emailed to hello@mrshkn.com, the studio mailbox hosted by Yandex.
Analytics data goes to Yandex (Yandex Metrica) and Google (Google Analytics 4), and only after you consent. Google is a service based outside Russia.

storage.title: Where and how long data is stored
paragraphs: The website and its database run on a Timeweb Cloud server in Novosibirsk, Russia.
We keep request data for as long as we need it to reply and work on your project. Email hello@mrshkn.com and we will delete it sooner.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: Yandex Metrica and Google Analytics 4 only start after you click “Accept” in the cookie banner. Until then your browser does not contact them, and after “Decline” they never load.
Without analytics, the website sets only its own cookies: your banner choice, the style and theme you picked and, if you came from an ad, campaign tags so they reach your request.
You can change your mind at any time: use the button below and the banner will appear again.

rights.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Email hello@mrshkn.com if you want to:
items: find out what data we hold about you;
correct or delete it;
withdraw your consent to the processing of your request.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This policy may change. The current version is always on this page, with the date at the top.

consent.title: Consent to the processing of personal data authorized for dissemination
consent.summary: Your signature, business, link and review text will appear on the studio’s website. Your full name and email are not published, and you can withdraw consent by email.
items: Who gives consent: the author of the review — the full name entered in this form; contact email — the address the invitation was sent to.
To whom: [Full name], self-employed (professional income tax payer), Tax ID [Tax ID], address: [Address], email hello@mrshkn.com (the “Operator”).
Purpose: publishing my review of the work of MRSHKN studio so that visitors to the website can read it.

Where it is published: the website https://mrshkn.com — the home page (https://mrshkn.com/ru, https://mrshkn.com/en) and the case page of my project (https://mrshkn.com/ru/work/[case address], https://mrshkn.com/en/work/[case address]). The review is published in the language it was written in. A translation is published only after I have approved its text in writing, labelled “translation approved by the author”.

What is published: my name as I entered it in the “How to sign the review” field; my business or job title; a link to a website or page, if I provided one; the text of the review — answers to three questions. The full name from item 1 and the contact email are not published. Photos are neither collected nor published.

Conditions and prohibitions (optional, Part 9 of Article 10.1 of Federal Law No. 152-FZ “On Personal Data”) are set with the checkboxes in the form: a ban on transferring the data to third parties other than for publication on the website from item 4; a ban on publishing the link from item 5; other conditions. If nothing is checked, no conditions or prohibitions are set. An unchecked consent box does not count as consent (Part 8 of Article 10.1 of the Law).
Term: this consent is valid until withdrawn.

How to withdraw: email hello@mrshkn.com from the address in item 1, stating your full name, email and which data to remove (all or some). The Operator removes the review from the website within 3 (three) business days of receiving the request (Part 14 of Article 10.1 of the Law).

license.summary: The text is published free of charge, without cuts or edits other than typo fixes. A translation appears only once you approve it.
items: I, the author of the review, allow [Full name], Tax ID [Tax ID], to use the text of my review free of charge under a simple (non-exclusive) license: to reproduce it and make it available to the public on the website https://mrshkn.com on the pages listed in item 4 of the consent.
The Operator does not shorten or change the text, except to correct typos. A translation into another language is published only after I have approved its text in writing.
This permission is valid as long as the consent to publish personal data is valid; if that consent is withdrawn, the text is removed from the website within the same period.
I confirm that I wrote the text myself and that it contains no personal data of other people without their consent.

mail.subject: {project}: three questions from Nikolay at MRSHKN
paragraphs: Hello,

This is Nikolay from MRSHKN. We built {project} together, and I would like to know how the work looks from your side. I will show your review on the studio's website — it will tell new clients more than anything I could say.

The form has three questions: what brought you to us, how the work went and what changed after launch. Answer as you like, short or long — I publish criticism too and only fix typos. It takes about ten minutes, no sign-up or passwords:
{link}
The form asks for your full name only for the consent — it will not appear on the site. The review is signed the way you choose, for example “Anna, coffee shop on Main Street”.
You can send the review only with consent to publish it — there are two checkboxes at the end of the form. If you change your mind, reply to this email and I will take it down.
The link works for 60 days. Thank you for the project.
Nikolay, MRSHKN studio
